**Status kinds:**

- **lb-tested**: probe # and public score.

- **open-untested**.
- **deferred-after-deadline**: post-29 Sep, or blocked by rule R8/R9.
- **in-plan**: slot/gate. 'APPLIED', 'RECORDED' or 'DONE' marks a finished ops item.

## NODES - Node budget & recall (track length, threshold, pruning, readmit/gapfill, hole fill, leaf prune)

Impact: Node multiplier is linear (0.001 per 1% nodes); every LB node-count lever was <= 0 except leaf prune (tie, probes 27 and 36) (CONTEXT.md l.1169-1171; experiments/RESULTS.md l.69). Round 11: the whole missing-node pool on x138 caps at +0.029 lab (1,211 FN edge-ends / 41,774), 80% multi-frame runs, mostly peakless in the raw image; a raw-maxima recall arm caps at +0.0059 (I-293); dropping nodes for the bonus costs ~21x its gain (research/wf_ideas_v4/round11/scan_hyp_detect.json r11d-1, r11d-2, r11d-4; scan_hyp_outside.json r11o-3). Round 12: node-drop arms rechecked on x138 are negative in both embryos (I-147, I-148), and annotation density per predicted node is 0.79% on 44b6 vs 5.20% on 6bba, so node levers flip sign by embryo (research/wf_ideas_v4/round12/scan_recheck.json).
